rules: This reservation and the exact V44 lagged-boundary coordinate must be committed before dev-v40 membership creation or model work.
Membership construction and disjointness verification are primary-agent-only and must not render seed values into agent output.
Dev-v40 must be generated solely within [8000000000,9000000000), disjoint by namespace from every prior governed set without reading their membership.
The committed one-way consumer must atomically create the dev-v40 umbrella attempt before its first manifest read or baseline episode.
A started, aborted, failed, exposed, or completed dev-v40 attempt consumes that set permanently.

Held-out-v6 remains governed by ADR-0053 and cannot be read until dev-v40 passes every frozen gate.
